author: Trevor Kearing
title: Traders Sell Apple (AAPL) on Strength (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Investors sold shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on strength during trading on Monday. $1,119.79 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $1,188.88 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $69.09 million out of the stock. Of all stocks tracked, Apple had the 0th highest net out-flow for the day. Apple traded up $3.13 for the day and closed at $220.79
Several analysts have recently weighed in on the stock. Loop Capital raised their price objective on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub lowered shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 12th. Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 11th. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Finally, Independent Research set a $270.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, September 14th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating and twenty-nine have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $217.66. Get Apple alerts:
The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,085.21 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 20.02, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.94 and a beta of 1.33. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period last year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.

Apple Company Profile ( NASDAQ:AAPL )
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
